narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly alike. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. In month {substitution_month}, {withdrawn_choice} was not available on this path, and the ghost took {substitute_choice} instead. In month {crossover_month} the ghost's money moved above yours and never came back down. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost held {net_worth_gap}.
